content:
Almost all of the textures in Minecraft have updated in Java Edition 1.14. However, I found that some textures that should be updated are not updated yet, such as the textures of Overworld signs, some GUI sections, and the back of paintings, etc. Besides, there're still some issues among the textures. So I made this pack - it will update all these textures, with some fixes of the GUI. So if you want your Minecraft to have a more coordinated look with the Texture Update, you should try this pack!

Fixed texture issues in this pack
  • MC-137913 - Oak sign item texture's text is brighter than that of the other signs
  • MC-144327 - The bottom face texture of a blaze's rods is the same as their top face texture
  • MC-151934 - Zombie's Clothes No Longer Matches Steve
  • MC-152331 - Barrier block icon in the spectator hotbar widgets is not updated
  • MC-152627 - Illusioners now have green eyes
  • MC-160720 - Bedrock part of end crystal texture uses old bedrock texture
  • MC-161416 - Inconsistent zombie villager textures
  • MC-168156 - Bow texture not changed in Texture Update and looks inconsistent with crossbow
  • MC-168716 - Items in spectator widgets, toasts icons, and stats icons use programmer art
  • MC-173455 - Empty armor slot and recipe button has yet to follow texture update
  • MC-189227 - First Time Tutorial Uses Old Textures
  • MC-191033 - Textures of "teleport to player" and "teleport to team member" icons have 1.13 eye of ender texture
  • MC-198202 - Options background texture does not match dirt texture
  • MC-199231 - Observer top texture has not been fully updated with the Texture Update
  • MC-201262 - Grass block top texture has not changed in the Texture Update
  • MC-206192 - Silverfish texture isn't updated
  • MC-214643 - Dye items still use the pre-1.12 color scheme
  • MC-214641 - Stained glass still uses the pre-1.12 color scheme
  • MC-219843 - Mycelium's side texture still differs from other dirt-based blocks, causing erroneous texture shifts upon certain operations
  • MC-222763 - Armor stands use the old smooth stone slab texture
  • MC-238927 - Music disc texture
  • MC-241850 - Miscolored pixels on double chest
  • MC-241898 - filled_map_markings overlay texture is improperly centered
  • MC-241997 - Stripped dark oak log top still does not match side colors perfectly / stripped spruce is similarly flawed
  • MC-242002 - Stained glass pane edge texture is still based on the outdated glass pane edge texture
  • MC-248841 - Piston side uses an older oak plank version for the wood/piston top uses an old oak plank palette
  • MC-109055 - Large Cocoa Pod texture is inconsistent (fixed in 1.19)
  • MC-150784 - Brewing Stand bottle outline incorrect (fixed in 1.17)
  • MC-152506 - Wither skull projectile has faces with old texture (fixed in 1.18)
  • MC-154006 - Overworld wood signs use the outdated wood texture on all sides (fixed in 1.17)
  • MC-160195 - Jungle door inventory texture is outdated. (fixed in 1.17)
  • MC-160388 - Painting back texture has not been updated with the texture update (fixed in 1.17)
  • MC-160256 - Texture of door items does not match the blocks (fixed in 1.18)
  • MC-165686 - Mismatched Knowledge Books (fixed in 1.19.3)
  • MC-194822 - Glass pane top texture has not changed with the Texture Update (fixed in 1.18)
